description: cfd_2d_compressible_box (sealed box, piston, W 32 2) with two refined levels (G 1 2, one time step for all levels G 7 0) in a box across the free surface: the composite pressure solve takes the compressibility terms of every grid. Over 2.5 s the air pressure follows p0 (V0/V)^1.4 within 9 Pa rms (6.7 kPa rise; 27 Pa without refinement); the probe at z = 1.2 lies in the level-2 patch.
covers: pjm_corr::amr_prepare comp_terms on the patches, cfd_amr composite solve with the compressibility on the diagonal
W 32 without pressure pinning in a closed domain with refinement
